title: introduce-region-anchored-role-hierarchy-and-audit-immutability-shim-with-kms-rate-limiter
author: Priya Menon
release_notes: Adds region-anchored role hierarchy (opt-in flag), immutable audit shim that seals audit records to a write-once store, and a tenant-scoped KMS usage rate limiter with metrics exposed under rbac.kms_quota.*. No public API changes; config flag behind 'security.region_role_hierarchy' and 'audit.immutability.enabled'.
body:
Title: introduce region-anchored role hierarchy and audit immutability shim with KMS rate limiter

Motivation: Some enterprise customers require region-scoped administrative boundaries plus guarantees that audit records cannot be retroactively modified. We also observed tenant-level KMS request spikes impacting downstream HSM quotas during long-running ops; a lightweight quota enforcer prevents noisy tenants from impacting others. This PR implements three coordinated pieces: (1) an opt-in region-anchored RBAC role hierarchy that decorates role decisions with a region claim and enforces deny-if-region-mismatch semantics; (2) an audit immutability shim that writes signed audit envelopes to a write-once backing store (S3+object-lock or on-prem WORM equivalent) and emits proof digests to the audit ledger; (3) a tenant-scoped KMS usage rate limiter that exposes quota metrics and soft-fails with structured retryable errors to callers.

Summary of changes: - authz/region_hierarchy.go: new package implementing RegionBoundRoleEvaluator and a small policy-layer adapter that short-circuits decisions when region claims mismatch. The implementation is opt-in via config.security.region_role_hierarchy.enabled. - audit/immutability/shim.go: adds AuditImmutabilityShim that wraps existing audit forwarders, signs envelopes using the configured audit-signing key (KMS-backed), and writes to a durable WORM store. Includes retry/backoff and local buffering for transient outages. - kms/quota/quota_enforcer.go: tenant-scoped leaky-bucket enforcement with per-tenant burst allowance and a global safety cap; metrics exposed via prometheus: rbac.kms_quota.allowed, rbac.kms_quota.denied, rbac.kms_quota.remaining. - config/schema.yaml: flags for enabling the features and default quota values. - console: added read-only indicator and a tenant quota panel under Operations -> Security. - tests: unit + integration tests for the evaluator, shim (using a fakeWORMStore), and quota enforcer. - docs/security/region-rbac.md: operational notes and migration plan.

Checklist: - [x] Design doc: ENG-4928 (linked) - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration test for shim write + verification - [x] E2E smoke test for quota path - [x] Console panel added - [x] Feature gated behind config flags - [x] Migration notes in docs

Commits summary: - 7a8c4d8: Add region-bound role evaluator and adapter (authz/region_hierarchy.go) - initial impl and unit tests - b2d49f1: Add audit immutability shim with signing and WORM write path (audit/immutability/shim.go) - c9e1f33: Tenant KMS quota enforcer and metrics + console widgets (kms/quota/*, console/ops)

Files changed (high-level): - authz/region_hierarchy.go (+120 lines) - new evaluator and docs comments - audit/immutability/shim.go (+230 lines) - core shim + envelope signing helper - kms/quota/quota_enforcer.go (+85 lines) - leaky bucket implementation - config/schema.yaml (+14 lines) - feature flags and defaults - console/ops/tenant_kms_quota_panel.tsx (+54 lines) - small read-only panel - docs/security/region-rbac.md (+400 lines) - migration and operator guidance - tests/authz/region_hierarchy_test.go (+80 lines) - tests/audit/immutability_integration_test.go (+180 lines)

Small illustrative snippet (authz adapter):
- if request.Region != role.AllowedRegion {
-     return DecisionDeny("region-mismatch")
- }

Runtime notes: - Feature is off by default. When enabled, the evaluator will add a deny decision if the request's region claim doesn't match the role's region binding; existing policies are otherwise honored. - Audit shim signs envelopes with the audit signing key; operators must configure the KMS key resource with usage permission for the service account. - KMS quota uses a combination of token refill and burst tokens; operator can tune via config.

Testing / CI: initial CI run showed a flaky integration test in audit shim (due to time skew in fakeWORMStore). Fixed by adding deterministic timestamping in test harness. Final CI summary: build: pass, unit-tests: pass, integration-tests: pass (one rerun), lint: pass, e2e-smoke: pass.

Review conversation (high level, chronological):
- Aisha Rahman (review): Please clarify how region claims are obtained for non-interactive service principal calls. Suggest adding fallback to instance-region on private deployments.
- Priya Menon (author): Reply: added fallback to instance-region via metadata service and documented behavior in docs/security/region-rbac.md.
- Daniel Ortiz (review): KMS quota should return a structured code so SDKs can expose retry-exponential backoff. Also please ensure metric labels include tenant_id and region.
- Priya Menon: Reply: changed error to KMS_QUOTA_EXCEEDED (http 429 with Retry-After), added tenant_id and region labels to metrics.
- Liang Zhou (review): Audit shim looks good; can you include an admin command to re-ingest proofs if the ledger becomes inconsistent?
- Priya Menon: Reply: added admin CLI reingest command (cli admin audit reingest --from <ts>) guarded by an RBAC role audit.reingest.
- Aisha Rahman: Approval after verifying tests and docs.

CI details: - GitHub Actions: build-and-test (matrix linux/go1.21, linux/go1.22), lint-step, integration (aws-mock), e2e-smoke - First run: integration flaky (audit shim test) -> reran single job -> passed - Final: all checks green

Backward compatibility and migration: - No breaking API changes. - Operators must explicitly enable security.region_role_hierarchy.enabled to opt into region anchoring. - Audit immutability requires configuring an object-lock enabled store or equivalent; when enabled, audit storage mode changes to append-only (operator action required and documented). - KMS quota defaults are conservative; can be raised via config.

Operational concerns and follow-ups: - Flag to temporarily disable quota enforcement via runtime admin (added). - Add alerting for rbac.kms_quota.denied > threshold (follow-up ENG-5012). - Consider making audit proofs exportable to external compliance systems (follow-up).

Merge outcome: squashed into a single commit and merged to main on 2026-02-25. Backport: none included in this PR; will prepare a small backport to the 2026.02 release branch in a follow-up.
